# Two posted vendor bills from two vendors, for the printing paths.
#
# Printing a *posted* bill is a different reader from printing a draft: the
# tax lines and the subtotal are derived from the posting transaction's
# splits rather than from the entries, and the payment block is read off the
# posted lot. Nothing reached either before — every print-bill test refused
# something instead of rendering it.
#
# One bill carries two taxes and a payment, the other neither, so a renderer
# that only ever sees one shape does not pass by accident. Different vendors
# and different dates, so `--vendor`, `--from`/`--to` and a glob each have
# something to leave out.
taxtable "GST+PST"
	entry:
		account: "Liabilities:Tax:GST"
		rate: 5.0%
		type: PERCENT
	entry:
		account: "Liabilities:Tax:PST"
		rate: 7.0%
		type: PERCENT

vendor "V-PRINT-A"
	name: "Alpha Supply"
	currency: CAD

vendor "V-PRINT-B"
	name: "Beta Trading"
	currency: CAD

bill "BILL-PRINT-001"
	vendor_id: "V-PRINT-A"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-10
	notes: "Two taxes and a payment"
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-10
		description: "Office chairs"
		action: "Materials"
		account: "Expenses:Office Supplies"
		quantity: 2
		price: 500
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "GST+PST"
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-11
		due: 2026-03-11
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-PRINT-001"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-20
		amount: 400
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Part payment"

bill "BILL-PRINT-002"
	vendor_id: "V-PRINT-B"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-03-15
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-15
		description: "Printer paper"
		action: "Materials"
		account: "Expenses:Office Supplies"
		quantity: 10
		price: 12
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-16
		due: 2026-04-15
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-PRINT-002"
		accumulate: true
